$comment: The versioned SemanticScopeDescriptor registry owned by multiverse/specs (PLAN_MODKIT_MK3_FINAL_RU §2.6). Until a scope is registered here its name is not a release or compatibility guarantee.

statuses.registered: the descriptor is complete, has conformance vectors and may be named in a release or compatibility statement
statuses.candidate: a pinned descriptor that exists for admission-only reports; it must not be used as a compatibility guarantee
statuses.reserved: the scope id and its owning block are fixed, the descriptor does not exist yet

scopes.note: computable today from common.view/model-scene-source@1 and from a UVM/core 1.0 artifact

scopes.registeredBy: block 12 slice 12-1, alongside the first UVT materializer
scopes.note: candidate, not registered: two of its four facets have no live publisher (a decoded raster region says nothing about sampler state or atlas regions), and there is no second independent texture path to write vectors against. It exists so a UVT MaterializationReceipt can name the scope it was taken under; its hashes are admission-only evidence.

scopes.registeredBy: block 12 prepares the candidate, block 18 freezes it at admission
scopes.note: reserved id only. No descriptor exists, so the name carries no guarantee.
reserved id only. No descriptor exists, so the name carries no guarantee.
